meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容编排成可翻页的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把想法整理成演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Create a navigable slideshow from your content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly need to turn ideas into a slide deck

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把内容组织成一套可逐页浏览的幻灯片,支持点击图中区域跳到别的页面,还带演讲者备注;也能把已有网页改造成这样的幻灯片。它产出的是能翻页的演示,不是视频文件。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做幻灯片、演示文稿,或说“把这个页面做成幻灯片”时触发;若只是说“做个演示/Deck”这类相近词,会先向你确认再动手。

say.text: 把这个网页做成幻灯片,保留原来的设计和动画
say.note: 会先确认,再转换成可翻页的幻灯片。

say.text: 做一个 5 页的投资演示,第一页讲行业问题
say.note: 生成多页幻灯片,每页一个主题。

say.text: 在第二页加个热点,点击跳到市场测算那几页
say.note: 添加可点击区域跳转到分支页面。

howto.what_en: Claude can build a navigable deck with discrete slides, clickable hotspots to branch slides, and presenter notes, or convert an existing page into such a deck. Output is an interactive deck, not a video.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks for a slideshow, or for adjacent requests like 'presentation', 'deck', or 'convert this page' — in those cases Claude confirms before building.

say_en.text: Convert this page into a slideshow, keeping the design and motion.
say_en.note: Claude confirms, then converts the page into a deck.

say_en.text: Make a 5-slide pitch deck, first slide about the problem.
say_en.note: Creates a multi-slide deck, one idea per slide.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on slide two that jumps to the market-sizing slides.
say_en.note: Adds a clickable region that branches to another sequence.
